subject.title: Discord routing: mention > reply-target > default owner (suppress default owner when targeted)

question: Should Discord multi-bot routing suppress the per-channel default owner whenever an explicit bot mention or reply-target signal points at another configured OpenClaw bot?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested precedence changes existing Discord routing semantics for default owners in multi-bot channels.

options.title: Adopt targeted precedence
options.body: Implement mention > reply-target > default-owner routing in the Discord plugin and add suppression tests for targeted cases.

options.title: Require explicit policy
options.body: Preserve current default-owner behavior unless users opt into a documented Discord multi-bot suppression setting.

options.title: Resolve reply policy first
options.body: Land or close the narrower implicit-reply policy work before choosing the broader default-owner suppression behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt targeted precedence
recommendation.body: Implement mention > reply-target > default-owner routing in the Discord plugin and add suppression tests for targeted cases.
